name: Rotini Pasta with Pork Sausage, Mushrooms, Zucchini, Tomato & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g ground pork sausage
salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
680 g white mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
When the sausage is done, add zucchini and mushrooms to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add tomato sauce to the pot, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, and basil to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
